### Moses Decides
Author: Michael Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-february-22.html
Passage: Exodus 4:20
Points:
- Moses chose to identify with God's suffering people rather than remain in the comfort of Pharaoh's palace.
- His initial impulsive intervention forced him into forty years of exile in the desert.
- At the burning bush, God confronted Moses with a second life-altering decision to return to Egypt.
- Despite his fear and reluctance, Moses chose God's glory over worldly ease and cut off all other options.
- Taking his family and the staff of God, he committed to walking in obedience to the Lord's call.
